text.p: Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson said on Tuesday it would supply network equipment to Omnipoint Corp and extend the companies' Personal Communications Services, or PCS, contract for equipment and services by $250 million, bringing their total business to $600 million.
The company said it would supply equipment for Omnipoint's Philadelphia Basic Trading Area and surrounding BTAs in Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
The contract involves a combination of IS-661 and GSM, including mobile switching centers, base station controllers and radio base station equipment as well as support services.
Omnipoint has PCS licenses that cover more than 96.5 million people, making it the fourth largest PCS operator in the United States.
